title: imap/mailbox: get_or_create_uidvalidity duplicates u32 clamping logic 3x
description: crates/imap/src/session/mailbox.rs get_or_create_uidvalidity() — the u32::try_from().unwrap_or_else(log-and-clamp) pattern is copy-pasted three times in the same function (lines 234-250, 243-249, 277-293). The same pattern also appears in handle_status(). Extracting fn clamp_uid(v: i64, field: &str, mailbox: &str) -> u32 would eliminate the duplication and make the clamping behavior a single auditable site.
